content.name: Experimental Shuttle Missiles
content.description:
The Experimental Shuttle carries one missile launcher, on one side, and ten missiles. The ten are not the ship's - its own magazine is zero. Every missile it carries comes from the launcher.
This mod mirrors the launcher onto the empty side and gives the ship a magazine of its own.
[h2]What it changes[/h2] [list] [*]Missile mounts: 1 becomes [b]2[/b] [*]Ship magazine: 0 becomes [b]80[/b] [*]Total missiles: 10 becomes [b]100[/b] [/list] Missile capacity is the sum of the ship's own magazine and the capacity of every launcher fitted, so the second mount is worth 10 by itself and the magazine takes it the rest of the way. Both mounts take any small missile launcher, independently - you can put a guided launcher on one and a dumbfire on the other.
[b]The ship model is not touched.[/b] A missile mount in X4 is not geometry: the vanilla connection carries no parts and no mesh, it is a bare point in space, and the visible hardware comes from the launcher's own macro. The second mount is that same point mirrored to the opposite side, at the same height and depth.
[h2]Settings[/h2] There is no in-game menu, and there cannot be one. A missile magazine is a macro property, read from file when the savegame loads, and the Mission Director has no action that writes it - set_ammo, add_ammo and evaluate_missile_storage all move ammo around inside the existing capacity.
So the number lives in the patch, as one line in extensions/ego_dlc_timelines/assets/units/size_s/macros/ship_ter_s_xperimental_01_a_macro.xml. Change it, reinstall, reload your save. Macros are re-read on every load, so no new game is needed and the change reaches ships that already exist. Setting it to 0 restores the vanilla magazine and leaves only the 20 the two launchers provide.
[h2]Dependencies[/h2] [list] [*][b]X4: Foundations 9.00[/b] - required. [*][b]X4: Timelines[/b] - [b]required[/b]. The ship only exists in this DLC, so the mod does nothing without it. [*]No other mod required. [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] Works on an existing savegame. For scale: of the 94 S-class ship macros in a full install, only 26 have any magazine at all, the median is 4, the highest is 20, and the closest Terran comparison - the Katana - has 6. Eighty is deliberately generous, and it is one line to change.
Source and full documentation: https://github.com/drjele/x4-xperimental-shuttle-missiles

text.name: Experimental Shuttle Missiles
text.description: Gives the Experimental Shuttle a second missile launcher, mirrored onto the side that has none, and a missile magazine of its own. Two mounts and a magazine of 80 come to 100 missiles, against the 10 it carries in the stock game. No change to the ship model. Works on an existing savegame.
